page.notes: Small dots and star-like marks in the margins and between lines (at "quam", "rejiciendo", "Argumento") are printer's specks or dots, not text, and are omitted. The "9" after "cap.5. 6. 7. 8." is read as printed; the "5" is an old-style figure and was read with some uncertainty. The printed word "argumentia" (non argumentia negantis) is left as printed. The running head "Priorem" ends in a ligature and is read as "Priorem".
